name: Harvey Pooka
source:
A mysterious girl with rabbit ears who suddenly appears before the protagonist.
Being somewhat translucent, only the protagonist can see her.

She is cheerful and innocent, doing things at her own pace.
She also loves reading manga and eating delicious food.

Amidst the strange life they've suddenly begun sharing,
Pooka continues to live freely, just as she pleases.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
